name: trace
useFor: Use to show what an agent did or is doing: one TraceLine per step with a TraceIcon, TraceTitle and TraceDescription (a duration). Set status running, pending or error. Wrap a step in TraceCollapsible with a trigger and content to reveal its detail (the request, the response).
constraints: Details open by default for every step
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (in-action.tsx steps, monitoring.tsx log, the rule)

title: Trace
description: An agent's steps as lines of muted 14px text with glyphs, mono durations, a breathing running step and details that open from a hairline.
